Test Case Description: Verify canceling logout confirmation keeps session active
PreRequisites:
- User is logged in
- Access to protected pages is available
Steps to Perform: Click Đăng xuất button in navigation menu
Step Expected Result: Confirmation dialog appears: 'Bạn có chắc chắn muốn đăng xuất?'
Test Case Expected Result: User remains logged in. Session is not terminated, tokens remain valid, and dialog is closed.

Steps to Perform: Click Hủy or close dialog (X button)

Step Expected Result:
- User remains on current page
- Access token and refresh token still in local storage
- User can continue accessing protected features
- No API logout request was sent
- Navigation menu still shows user information
